entries.title: Patron
entries.definitive_edition: Patron on Windows PC with Mare Nostrum

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Mare Nostrum DLC
primary.why: Patron is documented as a Windows city-builder, and the Mare Nostrum DLC adds new maps, buildings, resources, and production chains. Windows PC with Mare Nostrum installed is the only sourced platform and the most complete gameplay route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release on Steam or GOG with the Mare Nostrum DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mare Nostrum is gameplay DLC rather than a remaster; install it for the most complete version.
